Planning a visit to Turkey?

Agha Travel & Tours helps Pakistani applicants navigate the sticker visa or conditional e-Visa process with practical guidance, accurate application preparation and documentation tailored to the purpose of travel.

Visa at a Glance

Pakistani travellers generally need a visa. Depending on eligibility, the route may be a sticker visa or an online e-Visa. A conditional one-month, single-entry e-Visa is available to eligible Pakistani applicants.

Sticker Visa or Conditional e-VisaTurkey · from Pakistan

What You Should Know

The essentials of the Turkey Sticker Visa or Conditional e-Visa, before you start your file.

01

Who This Visa Is For

The e-Visa is not automatically available to every Pakistani passport holder. Eligibility depends on meeting the official system’s conditions; otherwise a sticker visa application is required.

02

Important Country-Specific Guidance

Do not rely on an e-Visa simply because you hold another country’s visa or residence permit; all current conditions must be satisfied. Visa validity and permitted stay are those shown on the approval.

03

A Personalised Application, Not a Generic Checklist

Each application is assessed against the traveller’s actual circumstances. Our team helps you present relevant information clearly and consistently, rather than adding unnecessary paperwork or repeating documents that do not support your case.

Checklist

Documents You Should Prepare

A starting point for your Turkey file. Our consultants tailor the final checklist to your travel purpose and profile.

Get My Checklist

For a sticker visa, expect

  • Valid Passport
  • CNIC, FRC and MRC (if married).
  • Last 3 months Bank statement.
  • Business or Employment details.

When visiting relatives, friends or for business

  • Host invitation
  • Proof of relationship
  • Your host’s status in Turkey

Turkey Visa Application

Practical steps, professional support and clear next actions.

01

How We Help You Apply

We check which visa route fits your circumstances, help organize the required documents and guide the correct submission procedure.

02

Application & Submission Process

Sticker-visa applications follow the authorized process in Pakistan; eligible e-Visa applicants use the official Turkish e-Visa platform. Fees and processing differ by route.

03

Before You Make Travel Plans

The Turkish authorities make the final decision. Verify current eligibility before paying for non-refundable travel.
